title: 1Hz vs. cTBS Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation to Augment Behavior Therapy for Tics: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
publication_date_type: medRxiv first posting and PubMed electronic date
date_history_timezone: Not specified in source XML; PubMed service history values retained verbatim
reviewer: dot; targeted single-assistant extraction, not independent clinical peer review
peer_review_status: preprint; no peer-reviewed successor verified; medRxiv published field NA
license_metadata: cc_by (official medRxiv API); no full text distributed
design: Three-arm randomized masked Phase 1 target-engagement/feasibility experiment.
population: Ages 12–21 with moderate-to-severe chronic tics; applicability to persistent severe adult illness unestablished.
comparator: CBIT plus sham; every arm received CBIT.
intervention_exposure: Ten sessions of SMA-directed 1 Hz rTMS, cTBS or sham followed by CBIT; no clinical-use instructions derived.
outcomes: Abstract neural engagement, tic frequency/controllability, urges, safety and feasibility; endpoint hierarchy differs across abstract/current registry/published protocol.
followup: Registry clinical outcome timeframe baseline to 3 months; preprint follow-up effects not verified.
key_result: Abstract reports unchanged SMA task activation, cTBS-related connectivity changes, tic improvement across all groups, and urge increase with 1 Hz versus decreases in cTBS/sham. No abstract clinical between-arm effect estimate or confidence interval.

adverse_events.caution: Event counts, affected-person risks and session percentages are different estimands. Zero serious events in a small selected sample does not establish broad safety.

attrition: 48/50 completed; neural outcomes have 45 total with different arm counts; reasons/full analysis flow not verified.
uncertainty: Full preprint inaccessible through inspected read-only web routes. Clinical baseline balance, effect precision, multiplicity, missing-data handling, exact session counts and historical amendment consistency unverified. Registry TST contrast and neural units ambiguous.
funding: Published protocol reports NIMH R61MH123754 plus institutional imaging support; preprint final funding not verified.
cohort_note: Preprint, current registry results and 2023 protocol describe the same trial, not independent replication.
claim_supported: A preliminary regimen-selection/target-engagement signal warrants scrutiny; findings need endpoint and denominator reconciliation.
inference_not_supported: Added clinical efficacy of cTBS over CBIT/sham, safety for all patients, durable disease modification, mature-adult efficacy or cure.
retrieval_status: Official abstract/date metadata, medRxiv DOI metadata, current aggregate registry results and selected published protocol methods inspected; preprint full text not reviewed.
